CS Kommunikationsbyrå AB bildades 2013 a: CS Kommunikationsbyrå AB was founded in 2013 by Carl Schnell and is based in Borensberg, Sweden, with a focus on the Östergötland region — but with assignments across Sweden and internationally. The agency handles all communication for its clients: social media, digital advertising, talks, drone photography, film and media advice.
Under åren har vi arbetat med tusentals: Over the years we have worked with thousands of customers and built a great many websites, mainly in WordPress. We have noticed that customers often cannot manage the site themselves afterwards, even when it is built in a simple way, and then need ongoing help.
Det vill vi göra enklare, och spara peng: We want to make that easier, and save our customers money. When Carl rebuilt cskb.se together with Claude — entirely through a conversation, without writing a line of code himself — he realised how much it changed the work. YourCoSite was born from that insight: a truly well-crafted site that you change yourself by talking to Millie, available to every business, not just those who happen to have a communications agency at hand.
